properties.description: Holds con:graph-construction-is-setup-not-work. Asserts a cold-versus-warm RATIO rather than a duration, because a duration threshold in a parallel test suite measures machine contention: the first version of this check read 266 us alone and 6 ms under `cargo test --workspace`, and failed. The ratio pins the structure that makes the code fast - the parse happening once - which is what actually broke and was actually fixed.
properties.name: Constructing a design graph is setup, and the schema is parsed once per process
